WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS actor
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1785347678643
    AND e.ts_ms < 1790186078643
    AND e.event IN ('subscription_started')
)
SELECT bucket, bd, SUM(val) AS agg
FROM (SELECT (((ts_ms / 86400000) - (((ts_ms / 86400000) + 3) % 7)) * 86400000) AS bucket, COALESCE(NULLIF((CASE json_type(props, '$."plan"') WHEN 'true' THEN 'true' WHEN 'false' THEN 'false' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(json_extract(props, '$."plan"') AS TEXT) END), ''), '(none)') AS bd, actor, session_id, ts_ms, (CASE WHEN json_type(props, '$."amount"') IN ('integer', 'real') THEN json_extract(props, '$."amount"') END) AS val, '' AS grp
    FROM ev WHERE event IN ('subscription_started') AND 1 = 1) t
GROUP BY bucket, bd
ORDER BY bucket
LIMIT 50000

)
SELECT bd, SUM(val) AS agg
FROM (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF((CASE json_type(props, '$."plan"') WHEN 'true' THEN 'true' WHEN 'false' THEN 'false' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(json_extract(props, '$."plan"') AS TEXT) END), ''), '(none)') AS bd, actor, session_id, ts_ms, (CASE WHEN json_type(props, '$."amount"') IN ('integer', 'real') THEN json_extract(props, '$."amount"') END) AS val, '' AS grp
    FROM ev WHERE event IN ('subscription_started') AND 1 = 1) t
GROUP BY bd
ORDER BY agg DESC, bd ASC
LIMIT 1000
